channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: I made Ina Garten's famous brownie pudding. The decadent dessert is perfect for the holidays.
item.description: Ina Garten first made her brownie pudding in 2008, but it has recently found new life on TikTok. The decadent dessert is perfect for the holidays.

item.title: My family has been vacationing in Punta del Este for decades. It's a hidden gem in South America.
item.description: I've spent my holidays in Punta del Este since I was 2. From endless beaches to kid-friendly culture and great food, here's why I keep going back.

item.title: Meet Pavel Durov, the tech billionaire who founded Telegram
item.description: Telegram founder Pavel Durov is worth billions. He has strong views on digital privacy that have landed him in legal trouble with French authorities.

item.title: Read Bari Weiss' new memo that defends pulling a '60 Minutes' segment and says Americans lack trust in the press
item.description: CBS News, Bari Weiss, and "60 Minutes" are at the center of a debate after a segment on El Salvador's CECOT prison was pulled.

item.title: I'm a business immigration lawyer. I'm telling my clients that if you have a valid visa stamp, return to the US now.
item.description: Tahmina Watson's law firm assists with employment visas. She advises all visa holders with a valid stamp to return to the US immediately.

item.title: In a new deal, Nvidia hires Groq's top engineering talent, including its founder, who built AI chips at Google
item.description: A new type of dealmaking is on the rise in Silicon Valley as Nvidia reaches a non-exclusive deal with a chip startup and hires its top engineers.

item.title: I left my university in Milan to study in a much smaller town. I loved the lower cost of living and slower pace.
item.description: I thought I would enjoy attending a private university in Milan. I quickly learned I had made the wrong choice.

item.title: A Pinterest exec who used to work at Meta says she looks for a defining quality in potential hires
item.description: Ayumi Nakajima said she values candidates who talk about their failures without spinning stories to make themselves look good.

item.title: This artist has 3 tips for landing a dream illustration gig
item.description: Ana Fedina made the art for Critical Role's "The Armory of Heroes," a guide to artifacts and weapons from the crew's "Dungeons & Dragons" stream.

item.title: Powerball just announced the winning ticket of its $1.82 billion jackpot
item.description: The winning numbers were white balls 4, 25, 31, 52, 59 and red Powerball 19. The Power Play multiplier was 2.
